title: Handover packages
description: Checklist configs inherited from project, edifice, floor, and unit

help.title: About Handover packages
help.overview: A handover package is a reusable checklist configuration for one scope: a project, an edifice, a floor, or a unit. It is not the ticking list on a sale. Open sales assemble an effective checklist by concatenating ancestor configs; ticks, completion dates, and who completed each item live on the sale.

sections.title: What a package holds
items: Project (required). Optionally edifice, floor, and unit — the narrowest field you set is the scope.
Title, optional description, notes, and attachments.
Checklist items: name (required), optional description and instructions, importance (low / medium / high).
Computed scope: project, edifice, floor, or unit. Packages have no status here, and items have no completed flag on the config.

sections.title: One package per scope
items: At most one package for a given project, one for a given edifice, one for a given floor, and one for a given unit.
Creating a second package at the same scope is rejected.
On create, missing ancestors are filled from the leaf (a unit package also stores its floor, edifice, and project).
Project, edifice, floor, and unit cannot be changed after create. Edit the items, title, notes, and media instead.

sections.title: Inheritance
sections.body: The effective list for a unit is additive: project items, then edifice, then floor, then unit. Missing levels are skipped. The same item name at two levels stays two rows, each labeled with its scope (Project / Edifice / Floor / Unit).
items: A project package contributes to every unit in that project. Edifice, floor, and unit packages stack on top when they exist.
You do not copy items down by hand. Open sales sync from whatever configs currently apply to the unit.

sections.title: On this page
items: Create a package — pick the scope by leaving lower levels empty (project only), or by filling edifice, floor, or unit.
Search and filter; open a card to inspect items and attachments.
Edit items, title, notes, and media. Scope fields are read-only.
Delete is a soft delete and can be restored. Removing a package updates open sales: incomplete items drop; completed items stay on the sale as retained.

sections.title: Ticking lives on the sale
items: Tick items from the sale (Update handover), not from this config.
Open sales re-sync when you add or remove items here. Sales that already have a title-transfer date are frozen — later config edits do not change them.
If you complete an item, then remove it from the config, the sale keeps that row as retained. You cannot untick a retained row.
If you remove an item that was still incomplete, it disappears from open sales.
Re-adding the same item name at the same scope re-attaches a retained row and keeps the tick.

sections.title: Title transfer
items: If Sales & handover requires a completed handover package, recording title transfer is blocked until every non-retained item on that sale is ticked, and at least one config applies to the unit.
Retained rows never block title transfer.
With that switch off, title transfer is not gated by this checklist.

sections.title: Related records
items: Sales — the ticking list, Update handover, and title transfer.
Sales & handover (Tenancy → Configurations → Real Estate) — the company switch that gates title transfer.
Units, floors, edifices, and projects — the scopes you attach packages to.

sections.title: Typical next step
items: Create a project-level package with the items every unit must complete.
Add edifice, floor, or unit packages only for extras that should stack on top.
On each open sale, tick the assembled checklist. Record title transfer when the gate allows it.
